meta.title: Angélique
meta.tagline: You enter a forgotten cave. Far below, something is still breathing.

strings.ga.s01.title: The Forgotten Entrance
strings.ga.s01.body: The cliff cuts off the wind. Between two blocks of stone, you see a low opening. Almost erased words still cover the rock. Night will fall quickly, but curiosity is stronger.
strings.ga.s01.c2: Enter the dark passage right away
strings.ga.s01.c3: Go around by the outer ledge
strings.ga.s02.title: The Dead Words
strings.ga.s02.body: Moss has eaten away part of the letters. Still, you can make out a few simple words. Do not enter. Do not call her name. Return before full dark.
strings.ga.s02.c1: Follow the signs on the stone
strings.ga.s02.c2: Look at the long claw marks farther ahead
strings.ga.s03.title: The First Step
strings.ga.s03.body: The ground slopes down gently. Very quickly, the noise outside fades away. The air grows colder and thicker, as if the cave were holding its breath.
strings.ga.s03.c3: Look behind you one last time
strings.ga.s04.title: The Stone Edge
strings.ga.s04.body: You move along a narrow ledge. Far below, the rock drops into shadow. On the side, another opening appears, more hidden and much older.
strings.ga.s04.c1: Cross the ledge above the drop
strings.ga.s04.c3: Follow an old mark on the wall
strings.ga.s05.title: The Dirty Rock
strings.ga.s05.body: Broken signs run across the stone. Between them, black dust sticks to your fingers. You feel like someone tried to erase a message without finishing the job.
strings.ga.s05.c1: Follow the draft coming from a crack
strings.ga.s05.c2: Look at an old drawing on the wall
strings.ga.s06.title: The Marks
strings.ga.s06.body: The marks are too long to come from a simple tool. Four clean, deep lines appear again and again in the damp rock. Something large passed through here, often.
strings.ga.s06.c1: Follow the dark stain on the stone
strings.ga.s06.c2: Pick up the engraved piece of slate
strings.ga.s06.c3: Listen to the gallery going down
strings.ga.s07.title: The Crack
strings.ga.s07.body: The passage is so narrow that the light breaks inside it. The air is dry at first, then suddenly icy. Farther ahead, everything turns black.
strings.ga.s07.c2: Search for a niche in the wall
strings.ga.s07.c3: Force your way through the smooth passage
strings.ga.s08.title: The Low Tunnel
strings.ga.s08.body: You move forward bent over, one hand on the rock, the other in front of you. The ceiling almost brushes you. You feel like you are entering something that is slowly closing around you.
strings.ga.s08.c2: Follow the smell of old cloth
strings.ga.s09.title: The Cold Chamber
strings.ga.s09.body: Here, the rock is smooth and covered with a thin mist. The silence is so clear that it almost becomes oppressive. At the back, three directions can barely be seen.
strings.ga.s10.title: Already Far Away
strings.ga.s10.body: The light outside is reduced to a gray spot. You realize you have gone farther than you thought. Going back already does not seem simple.
strings.ga.s11.title: Above the Drop
strings.ga.s11.body: The ledge is narrower than it seemed. Beneath you, there is only a thick darkness. Farther ahead, a makeshift bridge appears in the gloom.
strings.ga.s11.c3: Follow an arrow carved in a hurry
strings.ga.s12.title: The Rusty Iron
strings.ga.s12.body: The old anchor point still holds in the rock. Someone climbed here. Someone wanted to get through. You do not know if they got out.
strings.ga.s12.c1: Climb using the old anchor points
strings.ga.s12.c2: Look at the skeleton hanging farther ahead
strings.ga.s13.title: The Old Marker
strings.ga.s13.body: Simple lines, an arrow, then another crossed-out line. Nothing beautiful, nothing complicated. Just signs left behind to survive.
strings.ga.s13.c2: Compare the marks with the slate
strings.ga.s13.c3: Follow the tunnel with warm breath
strings.ga.s14.title: The Fresh Draft
strings.ga.s14.body: You place your hand against the crack. A real current of air comes out of it. It is the first reassuring thing since the entrance. But the crack is too narrow for now.
strings.ga.s15.title: The Simple Drawing
strings.ga.s15.body: The wall shows a series of lines, a climb, then a circle. Below it, a short line seems to mark a danger. It is rough, but understandable.
strings.ga.s16.title: The Helmet
strings.ga.s16.body: The helmet is cracked on the side. The strap is still closed. It has not been here for centuries. Someone entered this place long after the ancient texts.
strings.ga.s16.c1: Go back toward the old cloth and bones
strings.ga.s16.c2: Search for the circle of bones
strings.ga.s17.title: The Old Stain
strings.ga.s17.body: The rock drank something a long time ago. The shape has hardened into the stone. You do not want to look too closely, but your eyes keep returning to it.
strings.ga.s18.title: The Black Slate
strings.ga.s18.body: The fragment is engraved with clean lines. It is not decorative. You recognize the same pattern from some of the walls. This piece means something.
strings.ga.s18.c1: Keep it and compare it with the wall
strings.ga.s19.title: A Voice Too Far Away
strings.ga.s19.body: You almost hear a human voice. Not clear. Not close. Maybe a draft moving through a deep gallery. Maybe something else.
strings.ga.s19.c2: Search for the alcove with the chain
strings.ga.s20.title: The Niche
strings.ga.s20.body: At the back of the hole in the rock, there are remains of wax and a small worn symbol. Someone stopped here. Not to sleep. To wait, or to pray.
strings.ga.s20.c2: Search for a secret passage in the wall
strings.ga.s21.title: The Smooth Passage
strings.ga.s21.body: The rock is too smooth in places, as if something had rubbed against it for years. The passage squeezes your shoulders and slows every movement.
strings.ga.s22.title: The Drops
strings.ga.s22.body: Water falls in a steady rhythm. Each drop marks the silence instead of breaking it. You move through a chamber where every sound stands out too clearly.
strings.ga.s23.title: The Remains
strings.ga.s23.body: Bones, cloth, a piece of rope, a few worthless objects. Nothing was buried. Nothing was taken away. The cave keeps everything.
strings.ga.s24.title: The Forgotten Lamp
strings.ga.s24.body: The lamp is dead, but its presence is almost reassuring. Others made it this far. Others needed light.
strings.ga.s24.c3: Follow the steady glow farther ahead
strings.ga.s25.title: The Ledge
strings.ga.s25.body: The detour follows a huge chamber without making you go down. Caution saves time, but it also lets you see farther than you would like.
strings.ga.s25.c2: Go to the center of the void
strings.ga.s26.title: The Old Points
strings.ga.s26.body: The climb is old, but still possible. Some anchor points bend slightly under your hand. You keep going anyway, because down below, you already know what there is.
strings.ga.s27.title: The Torn Bag
strings.ga.s27.body: The fabric was opened from the outside. Not torn by age. Opened the way something is opened to be searched. The rest of the gear is useless now.
strings.ga.s27.c3: Look at the great engraved ring
strings.ga.s28.title: The Fork
strings.ga.s28.body: Three galleries start from here. The marks on the walls are old and incomplete, but they show that others hesitated in the same place before you.
strings.ga.s28.c1: Take the tunnel with warm breath
strings.ga.s29.title: The Bridge
strings.ga.s29.body: The bridge has been repaired several times. The knots are not all the same age. You place one foot on it, and the structure answers with a dry creak.
strings.ga.s29.c2: Join the bridge in the middle of the void
strings.ga.s30.title: The Arrow
strings.ga.s30.body: The arrow was carved quickly and with force. It is not there to tell a story. It says only one thing. Go this way if you still want a chance.
strings.ga.s30.c2: Follow the tunnel with warm breath
strings.ga.s30.c3: Search for the small low cell
strings.ga.s31.title: The Harness
strings.ga.s31.body: The skeleton is still caught in its gear. It stopped in the wrong place, or at the wrong time. You avoid looking up for too long.
strings.ga.s32.title: The Stone Mouth
strings.ga.s32.body: The walls narrow in places in an unsettling way. Even knowing it is only rock, you feel your stomach tighten. The passage makes you feel like you are being swallowed.
strings.ga.s33.title: The Same Pattern
strings.ga.s33.body: The slate and the wall tell the same thing. Lines return. A loop, an entrance, a closed circle. You do not understand everything, but you understand enough.
strings.ga.s34.title: The Warm Breath
strings.ga.s34.body: The air changes here. It no longer comes from outside. It comes from below. Slow, warm, steady. Like a deep, slow breath rising from the depths.
strings.ga.s34.c2: Follow the soot marks farther ahead
strings.ga.s35.title: The Soot
strings.ga.s35.body: The ground holds an old warmth. You touch the stone with your fingertips. It is not burning, but it is not normal either.
strings.ga.s35.c3: Search for the great wall of text
strings.ga.s36.title: The Prayer
strings.ga.s36.body: Water and time have eaten away the text, but a few phrases remain. Do not call. Do not feed. Close the circle before the final breath.
strings.ga.s37.title: The Dome
strings.ga.s37.body: The ceiling is black, as if an enormous fire had breathed here for years. Under that ceiling, every sound seems too small.
strings.ga.s37.c2: Go down toward the stone nest
strings.ga.s38.title: The Black Water
strings.ga.s38.body: The pool does not move. Even when you throw a small stone, the circle quickly disappears into the darkness. Something under the water makes you want to step back.
strings.ga.s38.c1: Try the path over the drowned stones
strings.ga.s38.c2: Follow the reflections in the water
strings.ga.s38.c3: Go around by the underground lake
strings.ga.s39.title: The Wet Corridor
strings.ga.s39.body: The ground slips under your shoes. The walls shine as if they were sweating. You move more slowly, feeling that one wrong step would be enough to make you fall.
strings.ga.s39.c2: Go around by the underground lake
strings.ga.s40.title: The Circle of Bones
strings.ga.s40.body: The bones did not roll there by chance. They were placed. Several pieces are missing, but the shape is still very clear.
strings.ga.s40.c2: Look at the great engraved ring
strings.ga.s41.title: The Lantern
strings.ga.s41.body: The red light is weak, almost dying, but it is still holding on. It marks a precise spot in the cave, as if someone wanted it to be found.
strings.ga.s42.title: Upward
strings.ga.s42.body: The crack climbs toward a clearer light. For a moment, you remember the idea of the sky, even though you know it is not the exit yet.
strings.ga.s43.title: The Old Line
strings.ga.s43.body: The rope still hangs there, stiff in places and damp in others. It was used to climb, or to flee. You wonder if someone let go of it in panic.
strings.ga.s44.title: The Stuck Pages
strings.ga.s44.body: The notebook resists when you open it. Some pages are lost, others still hold together. The words that return most often are hunger, heat, and name.
strings.ga.s44.c3: Go to the last human stop
strings.ga.s45.title: The Great Hall
strings.ga.s45.body: The space opens suddenly. Nothing protects you from the echoes anymore. You understand that if something comes close here, you will have nowhere to hide.
strings.ga.s46.title: The Red Signs
strings.ga.s46.body: The marks are not there to decorate the stone. They outline a passage. A threshold. Something that had to be crossed in a certain way, or not crossed at all.
strings.ga.s46.c3: Go down toward the center of the void
strings.ga.s47.title: The Void
strings.ga.s47.body: At the center, several depths cross each other. Natural columns support the chamber like the bones of an older world. Your heart beats too loudly here.
strings.ga.s47.c2: Return to the alcove with the chain
strings.ga.s47.c3: Follow the echoes of the great hall
strings.ga.s48.title: The Alcove
strings.ga.s48.body: The chain is still fixed in the stone. Heavy, cold, ancient. It is not here to hold a door. It was used to close or restrain something. One piece still seems removable.
strings.ga.s48.c1: Detach a useful piece of chain
strings.ga.s48.c2: Go toward the small low cell
strings.ga.s49.title: The Copper
strings.ga.s49.body: The plaque has grown dirty with time, but the letters still hold. One word remains clear: Angélique.
strings.ga.s50.title: The Old Threshold
strings.ga.s50.body: The gate has half fallen, but you can see it once closed an important place. The metal is twisted inward, as if something pushed from the other side.
strings.ga.s51.title: The Seam
strings.ga.s51.body: You trace a thin line between two sections of rock with your finger. The wall is not solid. Something was closed there with patience, almost neatly.
strings.ga.s52.title: The Breathing Chamber
strings.ga.s52.body: It is probably only an illusion, but the walls seem to move slightly, just enough to make you uneasy. You do not want to stay here long enough to check.
strings.ga.s52.c2: Go down toward the stone nest
strings.ga.s53.title: The Red
strings.ga.s53.body: Here, the rock takes on a dark, almost red shade. The air is warmer. Everything gives the impression that you are finally approaching the central place.
strings.ga.s54.title: The Removed Line
strings.ga.s54.body: An entire word has been scratched away. Someone wanted to erase it after writing it. The farther you go, the more you feel that the ancients knew something precise.
strings.ga.s55.title: The Black Dome
strings.ga.s55.body: The ceiling rises very high, then disappears into darkness. The marks above look like repeated passages, wide, powerful, ancient.
strings.ga.s55.c1: Go down toward the stone nest
strings.ga.s56.title: The Chain Over the Water
strings.ga.s56.body: Above the black water, the path is broken and very unstable. If you detached a piece of chain earlier, you can finally secure yourself a little. Otherwise, every step feels like a very bad idea.
strings.ga.s56.c1: Cross with the chain you recovered
strings.ga.s56.c2: Look at the reflections in the water
strings.ga.s56.c3: Go around by the underground lake
strings.ga.s57.title: The Drowned Stones
strings.ga.s57.body: A few stones rise just enough to cross. They are slippery, badly spaced, and the water between them shows nothing.
strings.ga.s57.c1: Follow the reflections in the water
strings.ga.s57.c2: Go around by the underground lake
strings.ga.s58.title: The Throat
strings.ga.s58.body: The passage squeezes your chest and forces you to breathe slowly. Water runs along your forearms. You keep going because going back seems even worse.
strings.ga.s59.title: The Steady Glow
strings.ga.s59.body: An old light marks another human presence that once passed through here. It is not the exit, but it proves that part of the cave can still be crossed.
strings.ga.s59.c2: Go to the last human stop
strings.ga.s60.title: The Chimney
strings.ga.s60.body: A pale light falls from above. It is not enough to guide you out, but it reminds you that the world still exists overhead.
strings.ga.s61.title: The Iron Door
strings.ga.s61.body: The door is old and almost sealed by rust. Still, you can clearly see it was used. Recent marks still damage the edge.
strings.ga.s62.title: The Camp
strings.ga.s62.body: Someone lived here for a while. A blanket, cans, tools, remains of a fire. You do not set up a camp like this if you think you will get out quickly.
strings.ga.s62.c1: Search for the last human stop
strings.ga.s63.title: The White Chalk
strings.ga.s63.body: The chamber is brighter than the others because of the chalk dust. Hands marked the walls. Human hands. Many of them.
strings.ga.s64.title: The Ring
strings.ga.s64.body: The engraved circle is not decorative. It closes a space. It holds something back or keeps something in order. You feel it before you understand it.
strings.ga.s64.c1: Go to the small low cell
strings.ga.s65.title: The Nest
strings.ga.s65.body: Bones, cloth, human objects, and smoothed stones form a kind of bed. Not a place to pass through. A place that is inhabited.
strings.ga.s66.title: The Middle Bridge
strings.ga.s66.body: In the middle of the bridge, you see several depths opening beneath you. You cannot see the bottom. The old footprints all go in the same direction.
strings.ga.s67.title: The Cell
strings.ga.s67.body: The small chamber is closed with old chains. This was not a normal prison. Something had to stay inside. Or outside.
strings.ga.s68.title: The Broken Name
strings.ga.s68.body: The name was broken on the plaque, then repeated elsewhere. Everything points to the same presence, but as if the ancients avoided writing her name all the way through.
strings.ga.s68.c2: Follow the echoes of the great hall
strings.ga.s69.title: The Gate
strings.ga.s69.body: The gate was bent with slow force. Not blasted apart. Opened. You pass through the twisted space, trying not to think about what deformed it.
strings.ga.s70.title: The Secret Passage
strings.ga.s70.body: The opening is so narrow that you have to turn sideways. Behind it, the cave changes immediately. The air is calmer, but not safer.
strings.ga.s71.title: The Round Chamber
strings.ga.s71.body: The shapes of the rock are strangely smooth and curved. Here, everything seems older than the rest. Deeper too.
strings.ga.s72.title: The Warm Gallery
strings.ga.s72.body: The red spreads across the walls. The warm breath returns, clearer now. You no longer really feel like you are searching for an exit. You feel like you are approaching something alive.
strings.ga.s73.title: The Altar
strings.ga.s73.body: The altar is simple, worn, heavy. The remains of wax and bones leave no doubt. People came here to ask for something, hold something back, or calm something down.
strings.ga.s73.c2: Follow the echoes of the great hall
strings.ga.s74.title: The Complete Wall
strings.ga.s74.body: You can finally read almost the entire text. It speaks of an ancient vow, a creature named Angélique, and a circle to close with the chain before the final breath.
strings.ga.s75.title: The Crossing
strings.ga.s75.body: The chain almost cuts into your palms, but it holds you above the water. Without it, you would already have fallen. The sound of the water beneath you is not the sound of empty water.
strings.ga.s76.title: The Reflections
strings.ga.s76.body: You do not clearly see eyes. Just glows, maybe reflections, maybe something else. But they are there where nothing should answer back.
strings.ga.s77.title: The Lake
strings.ga.s77.body: The lake fills an entire low chamber. A light mist slides across its surface. You feel that this place marks a real separation inside the cave.
strings.ga.s78.title: The Thin Light
strings.ga.s78.body: A little light passes behind a rockfall. You move closer, then you understand. It is not a real exit. Just an opening too small, too high, too late.
strings.ga.s78.c2: Follow the echoes of the great hall
strings.ga.s79.title: The Shelter
strings.ga.s79.body: Behind the door, someone lasted a little longer. A few belongings, a table, notes. The place makes you want to stay, but not for long.
strings.ga.s79.c1: Search for the real escape message
strings.ga.s80.title: The Last Human Stop
strings.ga.s80.body: A table, a canteen, a short message carved into the wood. Do not run. Do not call. Get out before she hears. You are not the first to read this.
strings.ga.s81.title: The Crate
strings.ga.s81.body: The crate contains leftover rations and deep claw marks. Even here, the survivors were not truly alone.
strings.ga.s81.c1: Follow the echoes of the great hall
strings.ga.s82.title: The Name That Returns
strings.ga.s82.body: In this huge hall, every small sound comes back distorted. As you move forward, you think you hear a name repeating from one wall to another. Angélique.
strings.ga.s83.title: The Threshold
strings.ga.s83.body: The final circle is carved just before the great chamber. Everything comes together here. The signs, the chain, the ancient text, the heat, the breath. You do not have much time left.
strings.ga.s83.c1: Move forward to the breathing hall
strings.ga.s84.title: Angélique
strings.ga.s84.body: The chamber is immense. You cannot see the whole creature, only a mass, a heat, a huge breath that fills the entire hall. Angélique is here. You have to choose now.
strings.ga.s84.c1: Search for the real exit while she is still asleep
strings.ga.s84.c2: Move too close and try to understand her face to face
strings.ga.s84.c3: Use what you understood about the ancient rite
strings.ga.good_end.title: ENDING — You Escape
strings.ga.good_end.body: You finally find a real opening. Cold air strikes your face before the gray light of dawn. Behind you, the cave becomes silent again. You are alive, and that is already huge.
strings.ga.bad_end.title: ENDING — Too Close
strings.ga.bad_end.body: You take one step too many. The breath changes. The darkness in front of you truly moves this time. You finally understand Angélique’s size, but too late. The cave keeps your last sound, then nothing.
strings.ga.secret_end.title: SECRET ENDING — The Truth
strings.ga.secret_end.body: You discover the origin of Angélique. The myth may have been born from a quarrel between a brother and his sister, then passed down and twisted over time until it became this story.
strings.ga.h.s02.soft: The erased words are not just decoration. They already give three simple rules.
strings.ga.h.s02.strong: Read the warnings carefully. They announce the name, the darkness, and the need to return before it is too late.
strings.ga.h.s10.soft: When the outside light is already far away, it is better to look for human traces.
strings.ga.h.s10.strong: The climbing bag and the old chambers can teach you how others tried to survive.
strings.ga.h.s14.soft: A draft is often a good sign. But here, it is not enough on its own.
strings.ga.h.s14.strong: The crack points to a real path out, but you first need to understand the cave better.
strings.ga.h.s18.soft: The engraved fragment becomes more valuable if you compare it with other signs.
strings.ga.h.s18.strong: Take the slate. It helps you understand the ancient circle and matters for the secret ending.
strings.ga.h.s23.soft: The human remains show that some people tried specific paths before you.
strings.ga.h.s23.strong: Look at the skeleton, the circle of bones, and the crossing. These areas give very useful clues.
strings.ga.h.s29.soft: The bridge seems to hold, but it mostly leads to another key area.
strings.ga.h.s29.strong: The bridge can take you to the alcove. That is where you can recover the useful chain.
strings.ga.h.s33.soft: When two signs look alike, it is never by chance.
strings.ga.h.s33.strong: Compare the slate with the wall. It leads you to the prayer, then to the old vow.
strings.ga.h.s36.soft: The prayer does not tell everything, but it gives the logic of the rite.
strings.ga.h.s36.strong: Read the prayer, then search for the complete wall. The old vow is a key to understanding.
strings.ga.h.s48.soft: The chain is not just decoration. Part of it can still be useful.
strings.ga.h.s48.strong: Detach the useful piece. It helps with an important crossing and matters for the secret ending.
strings.ga.h.s56.soft: Above the black water, safety is better than speed.
strings.ga.h.s56.strong: The safe crossing requires the chain recovered from the alcove.
strings.ga.h.s64.soft: The great ring and the final circle speak of the same idea.
strings.ga.h.s64.strong: The ancient circle is used to hold back or close something. If you want to understand, continue toward the complete wall.
strings.ga.h.s74.soft: The old vow finally brings together the signs, the chain, and the breath.
strings.ga.h.s74.strong: Read the complete text. It gives the true logic of the rite and matters for the secret ending.
strings.ga.h.s84.soft: The final decision depends on what you understood during the whole descent.
strings.ga.h.s84.strong: Good ending by fleeing through the real exit. Bad ending by moving too close. Secret ending if you have the slate, the chain, and the vow.
